usedFor: Chargebee holds subscriptions and invoices, and viaSocket utilities hands each “Subscription Is Cancelled” to another workflow through “Flow in Flow”.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscription Is Cancelled” in Chargebee, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation starts a separate workflow, so the follow-up steps live in one place.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” must be pointed at the workflow to run, so choose it before any event arrives.
